note: f = forward-renderer fraction of end-to-end training iteration time. NOT measured upstream (F0 scope EXCLUDES training; upstream G2 uses q_weighted = p*f directly, no separate f). f is an ASSUMPTION from the standard 3DGS training profile (forward render is a large share). Presented as a SENSITIVITY, not a measurement. Do not read as a training speedup claim.
interpretation: With the production-representative renderer speedup (S_mixed~3.0), a 3DGS trainer whose renderer is 40-60% of iteration time would project to ~1.37-1.67x end-to-end training speedup, preserving quality (fidelity guaranteed by the rigorous certificate on safe tiles, exact fallback on the rest). Even the conservative bench number (S_mixed~1.37 incl. a host-to-device copy production does not pay) still projects to ~1.12-1.19x. A ~1.5x training speedup with preserved quality is scientifically meaningful and may justify G5 (per the F0 gate).
caveat: Real training speedup also depends on backward/densification/optimizer costs and on a CGT backward path (downstream of F0 PASS); not measured here.
